name: thinking-translate
description: Translates Claude's thinking and shows the translation right under each thinking block in the chat, with Claude Haiku or any Anthropic Messages API endpoint

translateTo.title: Translate thinking to
translateTo.description: Language each thinking block is translated into, shown as a quote under the block. off turns translation off.

translator.title: Translator
translator.description: haiku: Claude Haiku at low effort through your own Claude session. api: any endpoint speaking the Anthropic Messages protocol (Anthropic or a compatible provider), set below.

apiBaseUrl.title: API base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: For translator api: base URL, /v1/messages is added to it.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: For translator api: sent as x-api-key.

apiModel.title: API model
apiModel.description: For translator api: the model name the endpoint takes.
